text_block_list.text:
One day, after having lunch,
I visited the Trainer Lounge—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Lost little lamb.
Welcome to my perch...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Oh my, you have the look of someone carrying a heavy burden...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh... You must have come seeking rest.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
You have the ruler's permission.
Clothe yourself in mild intoxication, and wash away the weariness of the fleeting world.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Barkeeper, a mocktail for them.
Put it on my tab.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah... allow me to let you hear the trio woven
by orange, lemon, and pineapple—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
“—Her name is "Cinderella".
Stop time itself and lose yourself in the moment.”

Taking a sip of the served mocktail,
the sweetness of ripe fruit filled my entire mouth.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
That's our Master.
Trainer's expression has softened up already.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh... The feast of Valhalla has only just begun.
I shall entertain you all with an overflowing bounty of offerings!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Now, feast your eyes!
Upon the gift descended in pure white!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
And the sweet forbidden fruit!!!
Furthermore, on the threshold of death and rebirth!!!!

Tanino Gimlet lined up plate after plate of food
in front of Vodka and me.
There was enough to completely cover the table.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Man, I am stuffed! Thanks for the meal!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Well now... Trainer.
You haven't touched a single one, have you?"
choice_data_list: I just ate lunch, so I'm completely stuffed...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps I should have appraised it with my hidden right eye first.
...Yet rest assured, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I shall become the voracious glutton!!
I will swallow it all, devour it whole!!!!
choice_data_list: You'll end up overeating, so let's stick to a little.
Yeah, go ahead and eat it all!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I shall become the voracious glutton!!
I will swallow it all, devour it whole!!!!
choice_data_list: You'll end up overeating, so let's stick to a little.
Yeah, go ahead and eat it all!

text_block_list.text:
Fortunately, there were several Trainers in the lounge.
I suggested to Tanino Gimlet that we hand them out to everyone.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, all have an equal right to receive an angel's favor.
Now then, let us serve it to our fierce warriors.
Tanino Gimlet shared the mocktails and food with the other Trainers who wanted some. As a result, she avoided overeating!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh... I suppose I shall reap what I have sowed.
Now, it is time for total devastation!!!!
Mocktails and huge plates of food were carried into Tanino Gimlet's stomach one after another.
